answer: Sybil resistance is enforced by EigenTrust matrix factorization, reciprocity-weighted transitivity, and exponential temporal decay: an agent’s reputation loses half its weight each fixed interval, so sustained honest service is required to build durable centrality. A freshly spawned sybil begins with near-zero eigenvector centrality, lacks trusted incoming support, and cannot pass consensus, whether hidden in an atlas, an umber cluster, or an ocean of aliases.
